0|ce28867fd20c23cd769e78b4d619c4755bf71a1c|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"s390/qeth: don't clobber buffer on async TX completion
If qeth_qdio_output_handler() detects that a transmit requires async
completion
column2: it replaces the pending buffer's metadata object

column1: (qeth_qdio_out_buffer) so that this queue buffer can be re-used while
the data is pending completion.
Later when the CQ indicates async completion of such a metadata object
qeth_qdio_cq_handler() tries to free any data associated with this
object (since HW has now completed the transfer). By calling
qeth_clear_output_buffer()
column2: it erronously operates on the queue buffer

column1: that _previously_ belonged to this transfer ... but which has been
potentially re-used several times by now.
This results in double-free's of the buffer's data
transmits as the buffer descriptor is scrubbed in mid-air.
The correct way of handling this situation is to
1. scrub the queue buffer when it is prepared for re-use
2. later obtain the data addresses from the async-completion notifier
(ie. the AOB)
All this only affects qeth devices used for af_iucv HiperTransport.
Fixes: 0da9581ddb0f (""qeth: exploit asynchronous delivery of storage blocks"")
